extraction.Name: Edward Arcoren
extraction.Refused/Protested: I was not in favor of it but my two brothers already had theirs and when they tried to refuse theirs it was no use so they told me it would be no use.
extraction.Buyer: $7500.00 in cash. In addition I was to have the pick of four of his horses and to pay him for the horses $150.00, but when I had the horses at home he claimed that the ones I took were not his and I paid him $250.00 to settle for the horses.
extraction.NOTES: Did not ask for the patent. Does not remember signing a receipt for it. Has five children and a wife depending on him for support. Not in good health. Signed with an 'X' mark. Document number 5569. Sworn before Notary Public on May 7, 1929 (written as 1989 in document, likely error); commission expires 4-28-32. | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 49 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal.

recovery_notes.rationale: Source page header contained 'No. NNNN' which Sonnet captured in NOTES as 'document number' rather than placing in structured Allotment field. Hypothesis confirmed via BLM cross-reference.
